metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Drawstring Backpacks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Eco-friendly custom recycled PET drawstring backpacks for events and giveaways. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled PET drawstring backpacks are made from post-consumer plastic bottles, transforming waste into durable, lightweight carryalls. For marketing directors and sustainability managers, these bags signal environmental responsibility while offering practical utility at trade shows, campus events, or corporate wellness programs. The fabric resists tearing and prints cleanly with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer. Choose recycled PET to reduce your carbon footprint without sacrificing quality or style.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET drawstring backpacks in assorted colors with logo imprint, made from recycled plastic bottles.
